VisualTC — DICOM Medical Image Viewer

Version %1

Created by: Dr Marcelo Duarte - Brazil

Desktop DICOM viewer for CT, MR and other modalities, working entirely offline. No patient data is sent to external servers.

Intended for study and research use. This version is not a registered medical device (ANVISA/FDA/CE); measurements and reconstructions must be checked before any diagnostic use.
